help:
usage: scbolt <command...> [--config=<file>] [--references=<condition...>]
       [--reset-target=<module...>] [--trust-target=<module...>]
       [--trust-existing] [--old-file=<file>...] [--logging=<bool>]
       [--<parameter>=<value>...]

scBOLT is a software framework for Boolean network inference from
multi-condition single-cell transcriptomes. Built upon the BoNesis engine, it
provides a reproducible workflow for transforming transcriptomic observations
into executable Boolean models through state abstractions, dynamical
constraint engineering, and exact logical model inference.

Special parameters
  --config=<file>                 select configuration file
  --project-dir=<dir>             select project output directory
  --resources-dir=<dir>           select resource directory
  --references=<condition...>     select references
                                  default: unnamed
  --reset-target=<module...>      rebuild from modules
  --trust-target=<module...>      skip rebuilding modules
  --trust-existing                skip rebuilding existing outputs
  --old-file=<file>               trust existing DAG file
  --logging=<bool>                enable logging
  --help                          display command help
  --<parameter>=<value>           override configuration value

Utilities
  init                    initialize a project
  version                 display version information
  help                    display help
  config                  display the effective configuration
  progress                display module progress
  check                   validate module requirements
  diagnostics             report runtime and reproducibility diagnostics
  dry-run                 preview build dependencies
  clean                   clean cache, logs and selected outputs

Download
  load-genome             download the reference genome
  load-fastq              download FASTQ files
  load-matrix             download public count matrices
  load-signatures         download phenotype-related signatures
  load-cc                 download cell-cycle markers
  load-go                 download Gene Ontology resources

Alignment/Counting
  alignment               run the selected alignment/counting workflow
  cellranger              perform alignment and counting with Cell Ranger
  star                    perform alignment and counting with STAR
  qc                      perform alignment quality control
  velocyto                generate spliced and unspliced counts

Preprocessing
  filtering               filter low-quality cells and genes
  normalization           normalize transcript counts

Clustering
  clustering              identify cell populations
  dea                     identify cluster-specific upregulated genes
  scoring                 score phenotype-related signatures
  goea                    identify enriched Gene Ontology terms
  annotation              assign names to cell clusters

Trajectory inference
  velocity                estimate RNA velocity
  potency                 estimate cell differentiation potential

Macrostate characterization
  cotan                   estimate macrostates with COTAN
  cellrank                estimate macrostates with CellRank
  stream                  estimate macrostates with STREAM
  knnsc                   estimate macrostates with KNNSC
  macrostates             estimate macrostates with the selected method

Binarization
  bin-cells               binarize cells with scBoolSeq
  bin-macrostates         binarize macrostates by voting rules
  bin-dea                 binarize macrostates by differential expression
  bin-consensus           combine scBoolSeq and DEA binarizations
  binarization            convert macrostates into Boolean abstractions with the selected method

Boolean network inference
  spec                    build the BoNesis model specification
  max-nodes-soft          maximize nodes (soft constraints)
  max-consts-soft         maximize strong constants (soft constraints)
  max-nodes-relaxed       maximize nodes (relaxed constraints)
  max-nodes-seed          maximize nodes (hard constraints, stage 1)
  max-nodes-lock          maximize nodes (hard constraints, stage 2)
  bn-min                  infer one minimum-edge BN
  bn-submin               enumerate subset-minimal BNs
  bn-diverse              sample diverse sparsest BNs

Use 'scbolt <command> help' for help on the commands above.
